name: indexed_sessions
description: Internal (session indexing): every indexed session of a harness with the fingerprint of its indexed turns and of its summary.

name: index_session
description: Internal (session indexing): writes a session's properties and drops its turns before they are written again; the fingerprint is set by the last index_turns.

name: index_turns
description: Internal (session indexing): writes a batch of a session's turns; a non-empty fingerprint marks the session as completely indexed.

name: set_summary
description: Internal (session summaries): stores a session's summary and replaces its facts.

name: merge_project
description: Internal (graphersal-memory projects merge): moves every vertex of project `from` into project `into`.

name: export_memories
description: Internal (uninstall, export --to-files): every memory with what the file memory format keeps.

name: start_context
description: Internal (session start): the memories loaded into the start of every session (pinned, feedback, user) of a project and the global ones.

name: open_conflicts
description: Internal (session start, status, import): the open conflicts between a project's and the global memories, and how many imported memories wait for their conflict check.

name: migrate_import_sources
description: Internal (once, at the daemon's start): memories imported before the import marked them get their file as source and their import time.

name: link_memories
description: Internal (session indexing): links a session to the memories its transcript wrote through the memory tools (wrote edges, replaced as a whole on every call, so a repeated call changes nothing).
